t: This is the Guards Memorial, standing on the west side of Horse Guards Road, opposite Horse Guards Parade. It commemorates the war dead of the Guards Division in the First World War, and of the Household Division in the Second World War and other conflicts since 1918. The sculptor was Gilbert Ledward, an English sculptor who made it. The architect Harold Chalton Bradshaw designed it. Bradshaw was born in Liverpool, won the first Rome scholarship in Architecture in 1913, and became the first Secretary of the Royal Fine Art Commission.
